decisions.reason: The original-specific design tests all four Chinese-GWAS non-HLA loci, not merely the two highlighted in the abstract title. Results report23of28tested markers unassociated and identify significant NOD2/CCDC122-LACC1 markers, with Discussion confirming those loci and retaining nonvalidated-gene limitations. This supports partial/mixed validation of the earlier multi-locus finding, not wholesale success or failure of all Chinese findings. Tag SNPs/new associated markers and Brazilian internal follow-up samples are not confused with separate original papers.

decisions.reason: The actual Hille/Schupp findings are independently identified in the Introduction: higher academic achievement, conscientiousness and openness among musicians. Current Results/Discussion retain conscientiousness/openness associations but contradict the broad academic-achievement result (with some German-grade subgroup agreement). Agreement is therefore not borrowed solely from Corrigall2013. The primary paper itself inconsistently describes prior perceived-control findings in Introduction versus Discussion; neither version is needed to force a categorical outcome. Actual original-specific agreement and disagreement support mixed.
